fields.description: Owner-selected reporting review interval; decision input only. No current report runner consumes this value.
fields.label: Reporting review days

fields.description: Owner-selected planning target, decision input only; class membership enforcement uses native Student Group max_strength, not this value.
fields.label: Class capacity target

fields.description: Owner decision input only; no current tax runtime reads this value. Native ERPNext tax configuration remains authoritative.
fields.label: Tax enabled (decision input only)

fields.description: Owner tax-rate decision input only; no current tax runtime reads this value. Native ERPNext tax configuration remains authoritative.
fields.label: Tax rate (decision input only)

fields.description: Owner display-inclusion decision input only; no current tax runtime reads this value. Native ERPNext tax configuration remains authoritative.
fields.label: Tax inclusive (decision input only)

fields.description: Owner decision input only; no current transfer command reads this value. It does not enable transfer behavior.
fields.label: Transfers allowed (decision input only)

fields.description: Decision input only; withdrawals and dismissals are governed by TH Enrollment Exit Policy. This field is not consumed by that resolver.
fields.label: Withdrawals allowed (decision input only)

fields.description: Owner calendar-notice decision input only; no current calendar or lifecycle scheduler enforces this value.
fields.label: Calendar notice days (decision input only)

fields.description: Legacy field retained only to preserve earlier policy-version data. Off-site backup is deferred future scope and this value is ignored by current runtime policy.
fields.label: Legacy — off-site backup requirement (deferred)

fields.description: Legacy field retained only to preserve earlier policy-version data. This destination is not part of current backup execution or release readiness.
fields.label: Legacy — backup destination kind (deferred)

fields.description: Legacy field retained only to preserve earlier policy-version data. Never store credentials or secrets here; current off-site scope is deferred.
fields.label: Legacy — backup destination reference (deferred)

fields.description: Owner-selected local time for the required nightly backup task. No default is supplied; the Windows central server must be available for the task to complete.
fields.label: Nightly backup time (local)

fields.description: Owner-selected keep count used only when the explicit retention behavior authorizes deletion beyond the count. Preservation mode retains all valid sets and does not rotate them. No default is supplied; at least two are required.
fields.label: Backup keep count for deletion mode (minimum 2)

fields.description: Explicit Owner decision required before any backup run: preserve all valid backup sets on the separate local drive, or authorize deletion of valid older sets on that drive beyond the keep count. No default; an unset choice keeps backup and activation policy unconfigured.
fields.label: Backup retention behavior (Owner decision; no default)
fields.options:
Preserve all valid backup sets
Delete valid older sets beyond keep count

fields.description: Owner-provided ASCII-armored GPG public key used only to encrypt the site-config recovery artifact. Public key material is non-secret. Never paste a private key; custodians keep private material outside Frappe and the backup drive.
fields.label: Recovery public key (ASCII-armored; public only)

fields.description: Human-readable custody requirement for the encryption/recovery key ceremony. This records requirements only; it never grants access or stores a private key.
fields.label: Key custody requirement

fields.description: Minimum independent custodians required for recovery. Actual custodians and ceremonies remain outside Frappe.
fields.label: Recovery quorum
